title: Drift or ocean change in the biogeochemical record
query: Using the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly oxygen, chlorophyll and nitrate for 1993-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), determine whether the long-term changes of nitrate and oxygen below the surface layer are ocean variability or drift and adjustment of the model. Examine how the changes evolve in time, how they depend on depth and how coherent they are in space, design tests that could tell the two apart with these fields alone, and state how far the product can be trusted for long-term change in this region.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
